blocks.body: A tankless heater fires only when a hot tap opens. Water passes through a heat exchanger and comes out hot for as long as you need it. Each unit has a flow limit, so we size it for the most hot water your home uses at once.

blocks.h2: Sizing a Tankless Heater for Your Home
blocks.body: Tankless sizing is about flow, not gallons. We add up what your home might run at the same time on a busy morning, like two showers and the dishwasher, and how much the water has to be heated in a Chicago-area winter, when incoming water is coldest. A unit that's too small will deliver lukewarm water when demand peaks. A unit sized for your real use delivers hot water for as long as you need it.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a Tankless Install
blocks.body: The unit, the gas line and the venting are the three big pieces. Many homes need a larger gas line to the heater and a new vent through a wall or roof. Isolation valves for descaling are part of a proper install. We check first and quote one flat price.

blocks.h2: Tankless Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: Will a tankless heater work in my home?
items.preview: Usually, with the right gas line and venting.
items.answer: Usually, if the gas line and venting can support it. We check both first.

items.q: How often does it need descaling?
items.answer: About once a year for most homes.

items.q: Will I really get endless hot water?
items.answer: Yes, as long as you don't need more hot water at once than it's sized for.
Yes. We descale, clean sensors and replace failed parts.

items.q: Does a tankless heater work during a power outage?
items.answer: No. It needs electricity for its controls and fan, even on gas.

items.q: Is there a delay before hot water arrives?
items.preview: A few seconds, a bit longer than a tank.
items.answer: There's a short delay as water travels from the heater, plus a few seconds while the unit fires up.

items.q: Can a tankless heater replace two tanks?
items.answer: Sometimes, if one unit is sized for your total demand. Otherwise, two units can work together.
